research_request: Using only this synthetic scenario, assess whether fictional issuer Solara Grid Holdings merits deeper diligence. Solara reports annual revenue of USD 310 million and EBITDA of USD 92 million. Sixty-two percent of revenue is covered by long-term power-purchase agreements; the remainder is exposed to merchant power prices. It has USD 480 million of debt, USD 38 million of cash, annual interest expense of USD 31 million, and 55 percent of its debt matures within 18 months. Two projects representing 28 percent of its planned capacity are delayed in permitting. Management reports no covenant breach, but the scenario provides no covenant headroom, refinancing commitments, counterparty concentration, audited financial statements, or independently assured climate metrics. State assumptions, identify supported risks, and list evidence gaps without recommending a trade.
branch_request: Reassess the same synthetic issuer assuming refinancing costs rise by 250 basis points.
